title: Consolidate parallel design tree: fold mdatron methodology-process docs back into vsdd-cli + crosslink
description:
Current state: 

Desired state: 

Reason: 

## What

I authored a parallel methodology-process layer in the mdatron repo (BOUNDARY-PREAMBLE, V1-SHIP-CRITERIA, BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION, STEP-2-SCOPE, dsl-falsifiability-report, .vsdd/events/, "Step 0.5 / Step 1 / Step 2" framing) that is parallel to vsdd-cli's own design tree. Operator diagnosed it correctly: the workstream should have been driven by VSDD's phase primers + crosslink's issue/knowledge substrate; instead I created an invented coordination layer that is now creating confusion.

## Why this is tracked rather than fixed now

Per operator directive 2026-06-01: "Mark as cleanup; continue current work; revisit after Phase A.1 lands." mdatron's Phase A.1 foundational work (JSON Schema dispatch, DSL parser, cross-file index, etc.) is the priority; consolidation cleanup follows.

## What the cleanup entails

When this issue activates:

1. DESIGN-MDATRON.md: relocate to vsdd-cli/ as a sibling DESIGN doc alongside DESIGN-SCHEMA.md, DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md, etc. OR keep in mdatron as a subsystem-internal spec — operator decides.
2. BOUNDARY-PREAMBLE.md: 8 declarations scattered to where they logically belong in vsdd-cli's existing docs (substrate composition, binary surface, cross-doc graph, artifact class split, install order — most already mirrored at Step 0.5).
3. V1-SHIP-CRITERIA.md: fold into vsdd-cli/DESIGN-METHODOLOGY OR file as a crosslink milestone for v1.0 ship.
4. BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION.md: the generic bootstrap-period methodology pattern belongs in vsdd-cli/DESIGN-METHODOLOGY as a sanctioned discipline. Specific mitigations either retire or become crosslink issues.
5. STEP-2-SCOPE.md: retire as a scratchpad. Remaining work items become crosslink issues.
6. .vsdd/events/*.yaml on both repos: replaced by crosslink session events when event-emission tooling lands. Until then, composition declarations go in commit messages per BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION § Mitigation 3 literal reading.
7. mdatron repo final shape: Cargo workspace + README pointing to vsdd-cli for canonical design + CHANGELOG + LICENSE. No methodology-process docs of its own.

## Going forward (process)

- crosslink issues drive trackable work
- crosslink knowledge pages hold canonical content (per the existing vsdd-cli pattern)
- vsdd-cli's existing DESIGN docs absorb mdatron-related content where appropriate
- mdatron repo stays minimal: Rust code + thin README

## Acceptance criteria

- mdatron repo contains only: Cargo.toml, mdatron-core/, mdatron-cli/, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, target/ (gitignored)
- vsdd-cli design docs absorb the load-bearing content from the deleted mdatron process docs
- Going-forward work tracked via crosslink issues, not standalone markdown scope artifacts

## Trigger

Revisit after mdatron Phase A.1 (foundational engine: JSON Schema dispatch, DSL parser, cross-file index, error catalog loader, 5 built-in patterns) is sufficiently mature that the parallel-design-tree pollution becomes the bottleneck.
